$comment: Reference schema for content/lessons/*.json. tools/validate_lessons.py is the authoritative validator (the standard library has no JSON Schema engine); this file enumerates required keys, allowed keys per object kind, enum values, and cardinality so the validator and any human reader agree on the shape. Every object kind below is closed: keys outside 'properties' are rejected.

properties.id: string, must match a course-catalog.json lesson id exactly once
properties.catalogRef: object (see catalogRef), mirrors the catalog record this lesson authors
properties.title: string, must equal catalogRef.title
string
properties.resourceIds: array<string>, res-* ids the catalog links to this lesson; a citation's resourceId must appear here

properties.id: string, unique across the whole lesson corpus
properties.title: string, nonempty

properties.id: string, unique across the whole lesson corpus
properties.citations: array<string>, sourceUsage entry ids cited by this block
properties.language: string, required for type code (use 'text' for prose-only migration explanations exempt from baseline lint)
properties.compile: boolean, required for type code; true only allowed when language == 'java'
properties.partialReason: string, required (nonempty) for type code when compile is false

properties.id: string, unique across the whole lesson corpus
properties.choices: array<choice>; must be empty for self-check; >=2 required for multiple-choice
properties.correctChoiceIds: array<string>; must be empty for self-check; >=1 valid choice id required for multiple-choice
properties.sourceUsage: array<string>, sourceUsage entry ids this practice draws on

properties.id: string, unique within the owning practice
string, unique across the whole lesson corpus
properties.resourceId: string, res-* id linked to this lesson in course-catalog.json with read.status == read
properties.locator: string, must match a fact locator recorded in the resource's source note

properties.id: string, unique across the whole lesson corpus
properties.resourceId: string, required for type external; must match a sourceUsage.resourceId in this lesson
properties.citationId: string, required for type external; must match a sourceUsage.id in this lesson
properties.description: string, required (nonempty) for type internal; internal references never masquerade as external sourceUsage

properties.baseline: string, nonempty (e.g. 'Java 17 / Spring Boot 3.x / Spring Framework 6 / Jakarta')
properties.limitations: array<string>; required nonempty when the lesson has no readable linked source (e.g. day-38, day-39-64, day-65-66)
